name: Althea
title: The Saint of What Could Have Been
description: A manifestation of 600 years of displaced hope. She does not fight with steel, but with the radiant memory of the warriors her family was meant to be.

passive.name: Divine Resonance
passive.description: Every time Althea uses a skill, she restores HP to the lowest-health ally equal to 50% of her MAG stat.

skills.name: Starlight Shield
skills.description: Wraps an ally in a crystalline barrier that absorbs damage equal to 2x Althea's MAG.

skills.name: Aether Prayer
skills.description: Purifies all debuffs from the party and restores 10 MP to all allies except Althea.

skills.name: Echo Fusion
skills.description: Special: Can only be used in Arc 8. Althea merges with Morgana to unlock her True Form.
